`npm run ci` now passes. I ran it again after the fix: the unit test, both Playwright tests and the CookieGuard security gate all pass.

**What was wrong:** The Playwright test `sign in and out` failed the CookieGuard check CG011, "Session still valid after logout". The `/logout` handler in `app.js` deleted the API token on the server and cleared the `sid` and `api_token` cookies in the browser. It never removed the `sid` session from the server-side `sessions` map. Anyone holding a copy of the old `sid` could therefore keep using the session after the user signed out.

**What I changed:** I added one line to the `/logout` handler in `app.js`: `sessions.delete(req.cookies.sid);`. CookieGuard now reports `logout revoked` for both `sid` and `api_token`.

I fixed the app itself and did not relax the security gate or the test.
